card.title: Sacred Procedure
card.instruction: Treat an ordinary activity as a solemn ritual. Protect every step, object, and tradition from casual interference.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please leave your sandwich wrapped. The picnic begins with three taps on the basket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The basket's in the car. Sam's driven off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we wait. This is a picnic, not people eating near each other.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll phone Sam. He can tap the basket for us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on speaker. No one unwraps anything until we hear the third tap.
